test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A principal of Rs. 40000 is invested at simple interest for 10 years. If the per annum rate of interest is 5 percent, then what will be the amount after 10 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 40000

Rate of interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 10 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (40000 × 5 × 10) / 100

⇒ SI = 200000 / 100

⇒ SI = 20000

Amount (A) = 40000 + 20000

⇒ A = 60000

**The amount after 10 years is Rs. 60000.**
